**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nadia8666/pa-tools/commits/v0.0.4

- Added `edgeFill.lua`, a new Studio plugin for previewing and applying fence segments or texture-aligned trim around selected surface edges. Supports multi-surface selection, cylinder end caps, and wedge surfaces, with adjustable trim dimensions and corner fitting.
- District Mapper now preserves per-section extrusion heights when its graph is reloaded or rebuilt.
- Fixed a local variable shadowing issue in Combine.

**TOOLS:**
_`paTools.lua` is a required plugin. Download other plugins as needed:_

| Name | Description |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `PASync.lua` | Sync code and attribute changes bidirectionally with full Team Create support and per-place configs |
| `combinePlugin.lua` | Combine arbitrary parts, meshes, and unions into optimized bulk meshes with precise collision |
| `districtMapper.lua` | Edit the district nodemap and edit height boundaries |
| `holeCutter.lua` | Cut holes into groups of parts and merge axis-aligned part groups together |
| `edgeFill.lua` | Preview and apply fence segments or texture-aligned trim around surface edges |
| `worldSelector.lua` | Bulk select instances within 3D bounds and compare spatial diffs |
